audit.whatIsWrong: Defiant Dance (W) was never mentioned in either layer, and the page twice attributed 'true damage' to Ionian Fervor. Flawless Duet was listed at 18s.
audit.why: Riot's text for Defiant Dance: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Garen's entire damage profile — autos, Decisive Strike, Judgment — is physical, so a charged W is the single worst moment in the lane to spin, and the page never said so. Ionian Fervor's text says stacking attack speed and 'bonus damage on hit' at max stacks; it does not say true damage, and I will not assert a damage type Riot does not state. Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, not 18s.
audit.corrected: Defiant Dance's physical-damage reduction written into Common Mistakes, late and spikes[3]; 'true damage' replaced with on-hit damage; the real Flawless Duet range written into report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart called Levels 2, 3 and 4-5 'Skill' and gave Irelia Level 6 — while whys[1] through whys[4] say 'stays yours', 'you dominate', 'remain yours', 'favours you'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Garen for all five early stages with Irelia only from first item, at 55.86% over 3029 games. Prose and packet agreed with each other; only the tokens dissented.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group to Garen through Level 6, Irelia at first item and 2+ items, and the two summary lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere; the tracked 'spike' was the placeholder 'Irelia passive stacks and Bladesurge minion lines'.
audit.why: Flawless Duet at 16s rank 1 is the punish window — it is her only hard CC and her engage. Bladesurge is 15 mana at 10s but refreshes off marked or dying targets, which is why denying minions matters more than its base cooldown.
audit.corrected: Flawless Duet's 16s/10s and the reset condition written into focus, dosFull[0] and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing, despite the itemization block already buying Executioner's Calling.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals Irelia on every dash, so in an extended trade her sustain is what beats Garen's grind — the anti-heal has to land before the long fight, not after.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds attached to Bladesurge's heal in dosFull[0].d.

notes: The highest-value find here is Defiant Dance: Riot's own text says she takes reduced physical damage while charging it, and Garen is a pure physical champion, yet the W appeared nowhere on the page. The 'four passive stacks give her true-damage shred' line was an invented damage type — Riot says bonus on-hit damage at max stacks and names no type, so I wrote what the text supports and nothing more. spikes[1] claims Q-silencing her 'before she casts Vanguard's Edge removes her whole disengage-and-stun window'; that is a timing claim the kits cannot confirm, so I left it alone rather than rewrite it.
